description: Erection of detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (LF/SS/3608 and unnumbered location plan- received 19/05/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those specified on the plans hereby approved or such uses which are incidental to the house at [15 Grange Road Chiswick  W4 4DB].  For the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation, nor for business purposes.
